headline: Premier League live updates: Aston Villa host defending champs Arsenal
description: Enjoy all the updates from Villa Park as Aston Villa host defending Premier League champions Arsenal.

headline: Tottenham approach Chelsea over Mykhailo Mudryk, Tosin Adarabioyo transfers - sources
description: Tottenham Hotspur have made enquiries to Chelsea for Mykhailo Mudryk and Tosin Adarabioyo, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Sources: Manchester City reach agreement for Everton's Ndiaye
description: Manchester City have agreed a deal with Everton for Iliman Ndiaye, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Spurs to make late move for Pulisic?
description: The deadline for the summer window in Europe closes tomorrow, and Tottenham Hotspur are interested in AC Milan winger Christian Pulisic. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Cody Gakpo set for Liverpool stay after Man City offer rejected - sources
description: Cody Gakpo looks set to stay at Liverpool after the club rejected a bid for the forward from Manchester City, sources told ESPN.

headline: Everton near deal for USMNT forward Folarin Balogun - sources
description: Everton are closing in on a move for Folarin Balogun after submitting a £35 million offer ($47.5m) for the AS Monaco forward, sources have told ESPN.
